subject.title: fix(codex): prefer recovered replies over stale failure banners

question: Should failed Codex conversation turns with only streamed deltas but no completed assistant-message item be delivered as recovered replies?
rationale: That choice changes user-visible message delivery semantics and could hide fatal app-server failures behind incomplete partial text; source inspection cannot infer maintainer intent for that product boundary.

options.title: Require completed assistant evidence
options.body: Suppress the failure banner only when `item/completed` or completed turn item text proves there is a finished assistant answer, and keep partial-delta-only failed turns as errors.

options.title: Accept partial deltas explicitly
options.body: Allow partial streamed text to replace failed-turn errors, but treat that as an intentional product decision requiring live Slack/Codex proof.

options.title: Wait for upstream signal
options.body: Pause until Codex exposes a clearer recovered-versus-fatal completion signal before changing OpenClaw's failed-turn delivery behavior.

recommendation.title: Require completed assistant evidence
recommendation.body: Suppress the failure banner only when `item/completed` or completed turn item text proves there is a finished assistant answer, and keep partial-delta-only failed turns as errors.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to this account as the strongest current owner for the Codex app-server bridge and conversation binding behavior.
